Card Q&A.q: Does "when this card would be used, reduce the cost by 1 for each [Deva] or [Four Sovereigns] trait card with a different name in your trash" include this card itself when I use it?

Effect: While you have a Digimon with the [Deva] or [Four Sovereigns] trait, you may ignore this card's color requirements.
When this card would be used, reduce the cost by 1 for each [Deva] or [Four Sovereigns] trait card with a different name in your trash.
[Main] You may play 1 Digimon card with [Fanglongmon] in its name from your hand without paying the cost.
Security Effect: [Security] Return 1 card with [Fanglongmon] in its name from your trash to the hand. Then, add this card to the hand.
